pin.title: Nothintsila, Ngqeleni (map point approximate): police shoot dead three suspected extortionists, 2 Nov
pin.location_note: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. Nothintsila gravel road, Ngqeleni (Nyandeni). Nothintsila is not in Nominatim, so the pin is the Ngqeleni town point (-31.6731, 29.0351). Area level, about 10 km.
